blocks.x: Oh, and I'd like to tell you about -- or did I tell you about it. I wanted to tell you about some of the things you hadn't heard about and I thought it would be just right for you to hear really, especially when we played the 500 Club, Buck and I in Atlantic City in the year of 1932 and we also played the Steel Pier in 1924 and the Steel Pier was on the boardwalk, you know that.
What is it about -- in particular about these performances that you recall?
These are stand-out places in Atlantic City.
Was there anything special that you remember about those particular performances that you did there?
